q1_issues.issue: The genitive possessor of the event nominal is promoted to (Agent sk_arrival_1 sk_group_1), whereas the Possessive / genitive NP rule as written routes a non-part possessum to (Possession <possessed> <possessor>) and nothing licenses projecting a nominalization's argument structure onto thematic roles.

"by post" is encoded as Instrument although Instrument is defined as the means understood as a tool or substance, and here the phrase is the copular predicate of "is by post" rather than an oblique on an asserted event.

q2_gaps: subjective genitive on a deverbal event nominal ("the soil samples' arrival" = the samples arrive) — the genitive rule and the event-noun-is-the-eventuality rule prescribe incompatible encodings and neither assigns the possessor a participant role

copular clause whose predicate is a means / method PP ("the arrival is by post") — Two kinds of clause covers only "is a N" and "is ADJ", and the entity-attached PP guidance covers only locatives, origin "from", and framing / domain PPs
notes: The group witness for the definite plural, the soil_sample compound genus, and the withholding of a genus for the noun modifier soil are all correct, as is the bare constant post for the article-less oblique object.
